WITH upd AS (
  UPDATE n8n_action_queue
  SET core_os_approval_id = NULLIF($2::text, ''),
      approval_requested_at = CASE WHEN $2::text = '' THEN NULL ELSE approval_requested_at END
  WHERE id = $1
  RETURNING id AS queue_id, core_os_approval_id AS approval_id, kind, summary
), log AS (
  INSERT INTO emma_events (source, level, message)
  SELECT 'EMMA_PROPOSE', 'ERROR', $3::text WHERE $2::text = ''
)
SELECT * FROM upd;

WITH cfg AS (
  SELECT $1::int AS cap, $2::int AS q_from, $3::int AS q_to,
         extract(hour FROM (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'))::int AS h,
         date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AS day_start
), quiet AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN q_from = q_to THEN false
              WHEN q_from < q_to THEN h >= q_from AND h < q_to
              ELSE h >= q_from OR h < q_to END AS is_quiet
  FROM cfg
), sent AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS n FROM n8n_action_queue WHERE approval_requested_at >= (SELECT day_start FROM cfg)
), pick AS (
  SELECT id FROM n8n_action_queue
  WHERE status = 'proposed' AND core_os_approval_id IS NULL AND approval_requested_at IS NULL
    AND NOT (SELECT is_quiet FROM quiet)
  ORDER BY created_at, id
  LIMIT GREATEST(0, (SELECT cap FROM cfg) - (SELECT n FROM sent))
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE n8n_action_queue q SET approval_requested_at = now()
FROM pick WHERE q.id = pick.id
RETURNING q.id, q.kind, q.summary, q.source;
